entity_name: Ogero Telecom (Office of Gestion et d'Exploitation du Réseau de Télécommunications)

facts.value: Owns and operates Lebanon's fixed-line telephone network and DSL internet infrastructure.
Manages submarine cable landing points (I-ME-WE, etc.) for Lebanon's international internet connectivity.
NOT responsible for mobile network outages. Mobile operators (Touch, Alfa) are under MOT supervision and are separate entities.
Customer care hotline: 1515. Customer care is available every day from 8:00 AM until 10:00 PM. Main office: Beirut, Bir Hasan, Ziad Rahbani Avenue; phone +961 1 840000; email ThePeople@ogero.gov.lb.
facts.notes: Verified on official Ogero contact page on 2026-05-24. Earlier internal draft value 1441 is rejected for Ogero customer care.

facts.value: Online portal: ogero.gov.lb. Complaint submission and service request available online.
Nationwide fixed-line and DSL coverage. Mobile networks are NOT Ogero's scope.
Official fault repair window for DSL/fixed line: 3 working days (per Ogero FAQ).
facts.notes: Verified on official Ogero FAQ on 2026-05-24. FAQ instructs users to contact customer care channels if the landline/DSL issue is not fixed within 3 working days.

facts.value: Customer submits fault report via hotline or ogero.gov.lb portal. Ogero dispatches technician. Escalate to MEW/MOT only if systemic infrastructure failure.

hitl_conditions: Mobile network complaint (route to HITL, not Ogero)
Unclear whether complaint is fixed or mobile
